mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% (UNRATE > 5.0) indicates labor market deterioration, signaling weak economic activity and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing supply contraction (INDPRO < 110), the S&P 500 tends to underperform in the next 20 trading days due to reduced economic activity and corporate earnings pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods when INDPRO < 110.

mechanism_narrative: A rising quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) signals strong economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings and investor confidence improve.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth rate is positive in the prior quarter but SPX 60-day returns are negative in 60% or more of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0% (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0), it signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a deteriorating labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and economic uncertainty.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative returns: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 2000 thousand units (HOUST < 2000), it signals a contraction in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate economic impact and market sentiment.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods when HOUST < 2000.
